basic_info.description: Popular Silver Terrace in Bayview! Single family home, sporting a BIG 3bd/2.5ba multiple level floor plan. Walk into an impressive living/dining area with raised ceilings, and enjoy the SWEEPING VIEWS from Portola to Hunters Point. More enjoyable stepping out to the balcony deck, catching views with a cool breeze! There's a remodeled kitchen with granite counters with stainless steel appliances. Guest bathroom, and interior access to a one car attached garage, all at street level. You level, a primary bedroom suite with dual closets and primary bathroom. Lower level, two secondary bedrooms, with access to backyard patio, full bathroom, and laundry. Excellent  view property high up, overlooking everything!  Built in 1987, zoned single family residential in a planned unit development. Guest parking close by, water paid by HOA. Close to SFMUNI, shopping and many local conveniences!
